publication.title: Building relatedness explanations from knowledge graphs
publication.version: Prepublication Semantic Web manuscript with DOI-bound final report metadata

source_reading.scope: Abstract, implementation and query-by-relatedness (§6), evaluation setup (§7.1), tool comparison (§7.4), related-work comparison and appendices.

adjudication.basis: RECAP implements human selection, visualization and filtering of relatedness explanations over RDF KGs and uses those patterns to discover further entity pairs. It includes a 20-person user comparison and algorithmic performance experiments.
